description: This is a Java domain model class representing a loan product provisioning entry within the Fineract accounting provisioning module. It maps to the database table 'm_loanproduct_provisioning_entry' and defines relationships to associated entities such as ProvisioningEntry, Office, LoanProduct, ProvisioningCategory, and GLAccount. It provides custom equals and hashCode implementations for identity and grouping logic, respectively.

classes.name: LoanProductProvisioningEntry
classes.description: Represents an entry for provisioning related to loan products, including associated accounts, categories, and criteria for provisioning calculations.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Custom equality check based on the IDs of associated entities and key fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code consistent with equals for using instances in hash-based collections.

methods.name: partialHashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash based on the core parameters to group similar provisioning entries excluding the reserved amount.
